synthesis.body: workspace.toml [backlog].open and docs/specs/ are separate registers with no cross-check, so the same defect can sit in both — once as a one-line backlog slug and once as an AC inside an Approved, queued spec that also owns twelve other things. Picking the backlog item and writing a fresh spec for it silently pre-empts the larger spec's task and leaves it half-done with no record. Before starting any [backlog].open item, grep docs/specs/ for the symbol or file it names; if a spec already owns it, tick that spec's ACs and annotate its plan task instead of authoring a competing spec.

title: A backlog item can duplicate a task inside an Approved spec
